bridge-type.label: GARDENA smart Gateway
bridge-type.description: The GARDENA smart Gateway, reached over its local WebSocket API. The WebSocket API has to be enabled once in the gateway's web interface.

parameter.name: host
parameter.label: Host
parameter.description: IP address or host name of the gateway, e.g. 192.168.1.20 or GARDENA-123456.local.

parameter.name: password
parameter.label: Password
parameter.description: The first block of the gateway ID printed on the back of the gateway, e.g. 1234abcd for the ID 1234abcd-996c-48f7-83dc-d2d1bac08e7e.

parameter.name: port
parameter.label: Port
parameter.description: Port of the gateway's WebSocket service.

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: How often the device list is read again, in minutes. The gateway only reports changed values on its own, so this keeps Last Seen current. 0 turns it off.

thing-type.label: Irrigation Control
thing-type.description: A smart Irrigation Control with six 24 V valve outputs.

thing-type.label: Water Control
thing-type.description: A smart Water Control or smart Pipeline Water Control with one valve.

thing-type.label: Dual Water Control
thing-type.description: A smart Dual Water Control with two valves.

thing-type.label: GARDENA smart Sensor
thing-type.description: A smart Sensor or smart Sensor II. Air temperature and light intensity are only measured by the smart Sensor.

parameter.name: deviceId
parameter.label: Device ID
parameter.description: The device's ID on the gateway, 24 hexadecimal digits. Filled in by discovery.

thing-type.label: smart Power Adapter
thing-type.description: A smart Power Adapter: an outlet that is switched on for a duration or until switched off.

parameter.name: deviceId
parameter.label: Device ID
parameter.description: The device's ID on the gateway, 24 hexadecimal digits. Filled in by discovery.

parameter.name: onDuration
parameter.label: On Duration
parameter.description: How long the outlet stays on when switched ON, in minutes, until its On Duration channel is set to something else. 0 keeps it on until it is switched off.

thing-type.label: Home & Garden Pump
thing-type.description: A smart Automatic Home & Garden Pump. In scheduled mode it runs for a duration when switched ON; in automatic mode it starts by itself when the outlet pressure drops and ignores manual starts.

parameter.name: deviceId
parameter.label: Device ID
parameter.description: The device's ID on the gateway, 24 hexadecimal digits. Filled in by discovery.

parameter.name: runDuration
parameter.label: Run Duration
parameter.description: How long the pump runs when switched ON, in minutes, until its Run Duration channel is set to something else. The pump stops by itself when the time is up.

thing-type.label: SILENO Mower
thing-type.description: A SILENO robotic mower: smart SILENO, SILENO+, city, life (also with LONA), pro, max and free.

parameter.name: deviceId
parameter.label: Device ID
parameter.description: The device's ID on the gateway, 24 hexadecimal digits. Filled in by discovery.

parameter.name: mowingDuration
parameter.label: Mowing Duration
parameter.description: How long the mower mows when started, in hours, until its Mowing Duration channel is set to something else.

channel-type.label: Watering
channel-type.description: ON while the valve is open. Switching it ON opens the valve for the valve's watering duration, OFF closes it.

channel-type.label: Watering Duration
channel-type.description: How long the valve stays open when switched ON, e.g. 15 min. Setting it does not open the valve. A plain number is taken as minutes. Starts at the thing's watering duration after a restart.

channel-type.label: Battery Level
channel-type.description: Battery charge in percent.

channel-type.label: Last Seen
channel-type.description: When the device last reported anything to the gateway.

channel-type.label: Valve Error
channel-type.description: The valve's error code as reported by the device, 0 for none.

channel-type.label: Valve Name
channel-type.description: The name the valve was given in the GARDENA app.

channel-type.label: Valve Connected
channel-type.description: ON if a valve is wired to this output.

channel-type.label: Temperature
channel-type.description: The ambient temperature measured by the water control. Meant for frost detection rather than as a thermometer.

channel-type.label: Frost Warning
channel-type.description: ON while the temperature is below about 5 °C.

channel-type.label: Radio Link Quality
channel-type.description: Quality of the radio link to the gateway (first-generation devices).

channel-type.label: Signal Strength
channel-type.description: Received signal strength of the radio link to the gateway (second-generation devices).

channel-type.label: Soil Moisture
channel-type.description: The soil moisture.

channel-type.label: Soil Temperature
channel-type.description: The soil temperature.

channel-type.label: Air Temperature
channel-type.description: The air temperature (smart Sensor only).

channel-type.label: Light Intensity
channel-type.description: The light intensity (smart Sensor only).

channel-type.label: Power
channel-type.description: ON while the outlet is on, also when a schedule switched it on. Switching it ON turns it on for the On Duration, OFF turns it off.

channel-type.label: On Duration
channel-type.description: How long the outlet stays on when switched ON, e.g. 30 min; 0 keeps it on until it is switched off. Setting it does not switch the outlet. A plain number is taken as minutes. Starts at the thing's on duration after a restart.

channel-type.label: Pumping
channel-type.description: ON while the pump's motor runs, also when it started by itself. Switching it ON runs the pump for the Run Duration, OFF stops it; both only in scheduled mode.

channel-type.label: Run Duration
channel-type.description: How long the pump runs when switched ON, e.g. 15 min. Setting it does not start the pump. A plain number is taken as minutes. Starts at the thing's run duration after a restart.

channel-type.label: Operating Mode
channel-type.description: Scheduled: the pump runs when switched on or by a schedule. Automatic: it starts by itself when the outlet pressure drops below the turn-on pressure.

channel-type.label: Pump State
channel-type.description: What the pump last found: whether it holds water and whether water flows.

channel-type.label: Outlet Pressure
channel-type.description: The water pressure at the pump's outlet.

channel-type.label: Water Temperature
channel-type.description: The water temperature at the pump's outlet.

channel-type.label: Flow Rate
channel-type.description: The water flow while the pump runs, 0 while it stands. The pump reports it in steps of about 76 l/h.

channel-type.label: Total Volume
channel-type.description: The water pumped over the pump's lifetime.

channel-type.label: Volume Since Reset
channel-type.description: The water pumped since the counter was last reset with the reset-flow command.

channel-type.label: Turn-On Pressure
channel-type.description: In automatic mode the pump starts when the outlet pressure drops below this, 0 to 10 bar. A plain number is taken as bar.

channel-type.label: Dripping Alert
channel-type.description: When the pump reports a small leakage: after 60 minutes of dripping (standard), after 2 minutes (sensitive), or never (off).

channel-type.label: Pump Error
channel-type.description: What the pump reports as wrong, if anything. Reset it with the reset-errors command after fixing it.

channel-type.label: Command
channel-type.description: Resets a counter or the error state of the pump.

channel-type.label: Activity
channel-type.description: What the mower is doing.

channel-type.label: Command
channel-type.description: Starts mowing for the Mowing Duration, parks the mower until its next scheduled start or until further notice (schedule paused), or pauses it where it is (second-generation mowers only).

channel-type.label: Mowing Duration
channel-type.description: How long a start mows, e.g. 2 h. Setting it does not start the mower. A plain number is taken as hours. Starts at the thing's mowing duration after a restart.

channel-type.label: Error Code
channel-type.description: The mower's last error code as reported by the mower, 0 for none.

channel-type.label: Cutting Time
channel-type.description: How long the cutting disc has been running over the mower's lifetime (first-generation mowers).

channel-type.label: Charging Cycles
channel-type.description: Completed charging cycles over the mower's lifetime (first-generation mowers).

channel-type.label: Collisions
channel-type.description: Collisions over the mower's lifetime (first-generation mowers).
